label: late original-phase j/f/z/v/1/t/p after several h/2/g/y/l/0/b tokens
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at t >= 3. 99% of mass is there, a little at <DEL>, and essentially none in the copy phase. Rate peaks at orig positions 5-7. It looks like an additive, graded unit. The current input token pushes it up, strongest for j, f, z, v, then 1, t, p; it is mostly the first occurrence of that token. Earlier tokens h, 2, g, y, l, 0, b push it up too, with the first original token weighted most (first_tok h/2 gives 4x lift, versus about 2x for prev_tok). Requiring the current token in {j,f,z,v,1,t,p} and at least two earlier tokens from {h,2,g,y,l,0,b} gives dev F1 0.42, recall 0.61, mass recall 0.71. Precision is low (about 0.32) because the threshold depends on a weighted sum, not on a crisp rule. The top activations (about 0.95 of max) are j/f/z after prefixes dense in h/2/g. Activations often continue at reduced strength on the next one or two inputs. It does not fire at t < 3 or during copying.
